coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer position at WEC Business Services LLC. My background combines software development, systems integration, production workload migration, and client support. As a Manager at DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform. This experience provides a practical foundation for the Cloud Platform team’s work supporting cloud-based applications and collaborating with development teams.

At DSTax Technologies, I migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS and led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform. I also optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput. My responsibilities include supporting integration implementations from requirements gathering and setup through troubleshooting and go-live support. Alongside development, I coordinate internal projects and client work, communicate status and integration updates, and maintain integration guides and knowledge-base articles. These responsibilities connect application delivery with the operational support and documentation needed to sustain it.

At Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers. I also initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work and managed SharePoint sites and data. Designing data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and support cross-department information sharing gave me additional experience translating operational needs into practical technical solutions.

I hold a BBA in Information Technology Management from the University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee. My technical skills include AWS, Docker, NGINX, GitLab CI/CD, Python, and REST APIs. I would bring this combination of development, migration, implementation, and troubleshooting experience to WEC’s cloud application platform work. Thank you for considering my application.

Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized AWS migration, platform upgrades, performance improvements, implementation support, documentation, and relevant infrastructure skills. The master does not establish two years specifically in infrastructure or AWS development, enterprise application scale, Azure, Terraform/IaC, shared-module governance, FinOps, CNAPP, Azure Front Door, AWS ALB, WAF, formal incident response/root-cause analysis, or rotating on-call experience. U.S. work authorization and sponsorship eligibility are unspecified.
